title: Two-shoulder glide study
summary: Both shoulder blades travel forward and back with a small collarbone response.

instruction.exploration: Track both shoulder blades against the ribs in the back view.

range.smaller_reference: The same relationship can be displayed with smaller angles and pauses between changes.

rest_pauses.note: The animation ends at neutral so the anatomical relationship can be compared.

variations.note: A lower-amplitude rendering preserves the same joint relationships.

cautions: This animation visualizes an authored movement theme and is not an Awareness Through Movement lesson.
safety.notes: The display does not replace verbal guidance, individual variation, or practitioner observation.

source.tradition_basis: Project-authored anatomical study using movement themes published by the Feldenkrais Guild; no lesson text, recording, or teacher sequence is copied.
source.rights_basis: provisional: project-authored record and animation using a procedural fitted-reference body; no third-party movement media or anatomy asset is packaged

review.notes: Requires review by a Feldenkrais practitioner and an anatomy reviewer. Muscle behaviours are illustrative anatomical hypotheses, not measurements of contraction or activity.
